SELECT t.purchase_org_name, t.supplier_name, t.images_url, t.productName, t.spu_no, t.sku_no, sum(t.orderQty), sum(t.orderAmount), sum(t.receiveQty), sum(t.receiveGiftQty), sum(t.receiveAmount), sum(t.stockInQty), sum(t.stockInGiftQty), sum(t.stockInAmount), sum(t.refundQty), sum(t.replenishQty), sum(t.returnAmount) FROM( SELECT po.purchase_org_name, pos.supplier_name, pd.images_url, pd."name" AS productName, pd.sku_no, pi.spu_no, count(po.id) AS orderQty, sum(pod.purchase_amount) orderAmount, 0 AS receiveQty, 0 AS receiveGiftQty, 0 AS receiveAmount, 0 as stockInQty, 0 as stockInGiftQty, 0 AS stockInAmount, 0 as refundQty, 0 as replenishQty, 0 AS returnAmount FROM purchase_order_detail pod LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON pod.purchase_order_id = po.id AND po.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_supplier pos ON pos.purchase_order_id = po.id AND pos.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pod.sku_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pod.is_deleted = FALSE AND po.approve_status = 'approve' GROUP BY po.purchase_org_name, pos.supplier_name, pd.images_url, pd."name", pd.sku_no, pi.spu_no
UNION ALL
SELECT po.purchase_org_name, pos.supplier_name, pd.images_url, pd."name" AS productName, pd.sku_no, pi.spu_no, 0 AS orderQty, 0 AS orderAmount, prd.receive_qty as receiveQty, prd.exceed_qty as receiveGiftQty, round(prd.receive_qty * pod.tax_price::numeric ,4) AS receiveAmount, 0 as stockInQty, 0 as stockInGiftQty, 0 AS stockInAmount, 0 as refundQty, 0 as replenishQty, 0 AS returnAmount FROM po_receive_detail prd LEFT JOIN po_receive pr ON prd.main_id = pr."id" AND pr.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON pr.purchase_order_id = po.id AND po.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_detail pod ON pod.id = prd.purchase_order_detail_id AND pod.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_supplier pos ON pos.purchase_order_id = po.id AND pos.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pod.sku_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE prd.is_deleted = FALSE AND pr.approve_status = 'approve'
UNION ALL
SELECT po.purchase_org_name, pos.supplier_name, pd.images_url, pd."name" AS productName, pi.spu_no, pd.sku_no, 0 AS orderQty, 0 AS orderAmount, 0 AS receiveQty, 0 AS receiveGiftQty, 0 AS receiveAmount, pid.stock_in_qty as stockInQty, pid.exceed_qty as stockInGiftQty, round(pid.stock_in_qty * pod.tax_price::numeric ,4) AS stockInAmount, 0 as refundQty, 0 as replenishQty, 0 AS returnAmount FROM po_instock_detail pid LEFT JOIN po_instock pit ON pid.main_id = pit."id" AND pid.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON pit.purchase_order_id = po.id AND po.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_detail pod ON pod.id = pid.purchase_order_detail_id AND pod.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_supplier pos ON pos.purchase_order_id = po.id AND pos.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pod.sku_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pid.is_deleted = FALSE AND pit.approve_status = 'approve'
UNION ALL
SELECT po.purchase_org_name, pos.supplier_name, pd.images_url, pd."name" AS productName, pi.spu_no, pd.sku_no, 0 AS orderQty, 0 AS orderAmount, 0 AS receiveQty, 0 AS receiveGiftQty, 0 AS receiveAmount, 0 as stockInQty, 0 as stockInGiftQty, 0 AS stockInAmount, prd.deduct_amount_qty as refundQty, prd.replenish_qty as replenishQty, 0 AS returnAmount FROM po_return_detail prd LEFT JOIN po_return pr ON prd.main_id = pr."id" AND pr.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON pr.purchase_order_id = po.id AND po.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_detail pod ON pod.id = prd.purchase_order_detail_id AND pod.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_supplier pos ON pos.purchase_order_id = po.id AND pos.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pod.sku_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE prd.is_deleted = FALSE AND pr.approve_status = 'approve' ) t
group by t.purchase_org_name, t.supplier_name, t.images_url, t.productName, t.spu_no, t.sku_no
